get_model_type: get the SpeechBrain model type for a HuggingFace model by reading its config
get_vocoder_model_id: get the vocoder model ID associated with a SpeechBrain model from its config
list_model_types: list all available SpeechBrain model types like ENCODERASR, WHISPERASR, and TACOTRON2
review_ModelType: review the ModelType enum to understand SpeechBrain model categories like ASR and TTS
refactor_get_type: refactor get_type to cache HfApi model_info calls and reduce redundant API requests
